summary: Post-join access consolidation and equipment transfer for converting contractor - SCIM group mismatch
description:
Issue summary:
A contractor (previously on a 6-month contract) converted to full-time on 2026-02-25. HR created a new employee record and SCIM provisioning created a fresh Okta user, but the legacy contractor Okta account remains linked to the company-managed M1 laptop and some service accounts. We need to consolidate access, reassign the existing laptop to a pooled asset (or transfer if requested), and ensure KMS tags and service-account ownership are rotated.

Impact:
- Potential orphaned service credentials still tied to the contractor account.
- Hardware inventory shows duplicate assignment for the same physical laptop.
- New employee cannot be added to the engineering groups via SCIM because of group mapping conflict (two Okta entries for same email alias).

Environment:
- Prod identity: Okta + SCIM sync from Workday HR system.
- Asset inventory: Jamf + internal AssetDB (us-west region).

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) HR change triggered new SCIM create on 2026-02-25.
2) Okta shows two users with matching email alias (legacy contractor and new employee record) — legacy user has primary_email set to alias+deprecated.
3) Jamf shows laptop serial ABC123 assigned to legacy Okta UID.
4) Internal AssetDB has laptop flagged as "in-use" and assigned to contractor service ticket INT-314159.

Relevant logs / snapshots:
- Okta user list (exported 2026-03-01) attached to ticket in support console.
- Jamf device record: serial ABC123, last check-in 2026-02-28.
- AssetDB record: asset_id ASSET-7890, owner: okta:uid-4578 (legacy contractor).
investigation_notes:
Initial triage (2026-03-02) by Support: SCIM created separate employee duplicate because HR Org Unit changed and Workday emitted a create instead of convert event. Okta still has legacy account with service-account tokens (CI runner) and an SSH key recorded in our secrets manager. Asset team confirmed device serial ABC123 is physically in office locker and flagged for transfer.

Hypothesis 1: Workday->SCIM mapping bug caused duplicate user creation rather than linking to existing identity.
Hypothesis 2: Jamf/AssetDB sync lag allowed asset owner to remain the contractor entry even after HR conversion.

Temporary mitigations applied:
- Rotated CI runner token tied to legacy Okta account (runner owner requested urgent rotation) — rotated 2026-03-03 by Support with Eng approval (PR ref: github.com/redwood/infra/commit/6a9f3b).
- Set legacy Okta account to disabled-but-preserve (suspended) to prevent new logins while investigation continues (2026-03-03).
comments: 2026-03-02 - Sofia Patel (Support): Created ticket after HR flagged mismatch. Notified Asset team and Identity team. Filed INT-314159 as follow-up referencing the device hold.

2026-03-03 - Priya Shah (Identity lead): Confirmed SCIM create event from Workday. Recommend merging Okta profiles rather than manual transfer to preserve audit trail. Need legal/HR sign-off to merge contractor -> employee accounts.
2026-03-03 - Marcus Li (Asset team): Laptop ABC123 is in locker B12. Will hold until we receive formal disposition (reuse vs. transfer to pooled inventory).
2026-03-04 - Jared Kim (Assignee): Rotated CI runner token and recorded action in ticket. Requesting KMS owners list to rotate key ACLs if we fully decommission legacy account.
2026-03-05 - HR (Elena Morales): HR approves account merge for audit continuity; asks that device be reissued to new hire if they confirm they need same laptop for dev environment.
action_items: Identity: perform Okta user merge workflow after HR confirmation (run audit export and attach to ticket).
Asset: finalize disposition of ABC123 (reissue to employee vs. pool). If reissued, update Jamf and AssetDB records and sign transfer form.
Security: rotate KMS ACLs and secrets for any credentials tied to legacy Okta UID (coordinate with Eng).
Support: update SCIM mapping rules to prevent duplicate creates for Workday conversions (follow-up INT-912468).
resolution: In progress: CI runner token rotated and legacy Okta suspended (2026-03-03). HR provided written approval for account merge (2026-03-05). Pending steps: Identity to run merge (scheduled 2026-03-06), Asset team to reassign laptop after merge confirmation. Will close ticket after asset record and KMS rotation complete.
